title: Production Mobile App Development
desc: Cross-platform mobile applications using React Native (Expo) and Kotlin for Android & iOS. End-to-end management of Google Play Console and App Store Connect / TestFlight releases.

title: Fintech & Payment Partner Integrations
desc: Core banking integrations (Safe Haven MFB, Monnify), CBN-compliant KYC tier systems (Tier 1–3, BVN/NIN), automated transaction velocity monitoring, and NIBSS interbank sync architecture.

title: Relational Databases & Architecture
desc: High-performance PostgreSQL and MySQL schema design, indexing, migrations, and ORM mapping (TypeORM / Prisma) for high-integrity financial and transactional systems.

title: Backend Engineering & Microservices
desc: Robust, modular REST APIs and microservices built with NestJS, TypeScript, and Node.js with strict validation, authentication, and error handling.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
desc: Self-managed Linux droplets on DigitalOcean, containerization with Docker, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, automated SSL (Certbot), and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
